item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Disable VNet peering route
item.description:
Azure announced public preview of Disable VNet Peering Route (DPR), a route-table capability that suppresses system-generated peering routes on subnets associated with the route table. This gives more control over traffic flow between peered virtual networks.

  • Source: Azure Updates
